name: reel
title: Reel
description: An endless reel of items. Straight, it loops them left, right, up or down like a logo ticker, with edge fades and a hover speed that eases to a stop. Given an SVG path, the items ride along it, round a closed loop or in one end and out the other, turned to face along it or kept upright; with drawable, press and drag to draw the path. Flow sends items as a stream, a number at a time or at random gaps; cycles, rest and loop set how many passes run before it pauses or stops, and playOnView starts it when it scrolls into view.
